title: What is NELFUND?
content: NELFUND is the Nigerian Education Loan Fund. It provides student financing for eligible tertiary students in Nigeria, covering institutional charges and/or upkeep. NELFUND is a loan, not a scholarship or a grant. It must be repaid.

title: NELFUND is a loan, not free money
content: Funding from NELFUND is a loan with real repayment obligations. Students should not treat it as a scholarship or as free government money. Understanding this before applying helps you plan how you will repay it later.

title: What NELFUND funding can cover
content: NELFUND funding can include two components: institutional charges (school fees and related charges) and student upkeep (a monthly living allowance). The institutional-charges component is paid directly to the institution, not to the student.

title: How much is the upkeep allowance?
content: The currently confirmed upkeep amount is ₦20,000 per month. Figures you may see elsewhere (including ₦25,000) should not be treated as current unless an official NELFUND source confirms a change. Always check the official portal before budgeting around a specific figure.

title: When repayment starts
content: Repayment generally begins after a grace period following completion of the programme of study. Confirm the current grace period and start rules on the official NELFUND portal, and follow official channels once repayment obligations are generated for your account.

title: How repayment works
content: Repayment terms include deductions from salary where applicable, once a graduate is in formal employment. NELFUND is a real financial obligation, and the repayment structure is designed to recover the loan over time rather than all at once.

title: What is GSI?
content: GSI stands for Global Standing Instruction, a mechanism NELFUND can use for loan recovery. It is generally linked to a borrower's bank accounts to support repayment. Treat the exact mechanics as general guidance and confirm specifics through official NELFUND documentation.

title: NELFUND-wide rules vs institution-specific procedures
content: NELFUND sets the general loan rules that apply nationwide. Your institution handles its own layer on top of that: uploading student records, confirming admission and matriculation details, and any local refund or fee reconciliation steps. When something depends on your school, confirm with the office responsible for NELFUND coordination at your institution.
